description: This file defines the ActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain class, which implements the IActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain interface. It manages activation and deactivation call logs, providing methods to record, retrieve, and clear these logs, and uses dependency injection for logging.

classes.name: ActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain
classes.description: A class that tracks activation and deactivation calls, providing methods to record, retrieve, and clear logs, with logging support.

methods.name: GetActivateCalls
methods.description: Returns the list of activation call identifiers as an array.

methods.name: GetDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Returns the list of deactivation call identifiers as an array.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the activation and deactivation call logs, with debug logging.

methods.name: RecordActivateCall
methods.description: Records an activation call identifier, with debug logging.

methods.name: RecordDeactivateCall
methods.description: Records a deactivation call identifier, with debug logging.
